title: KAY CRM database models
scope: Complete documented target CRM; not live database introspection.

mcd.title: Contacts and commercial relationships
mcd.subtitle: A single protected client identity can generate several enquiries and deals.
notes: Primary responsibility is singular; collaborators are an explicit many-to-many relation.
Roles such as buyer, tenant, owner and developer belong to the contact.

mcd.title: Development hierarchy and reusable types
mcd.subtitle: Villa, house, apartment and land can be standalone assets or actual units.
notes: Block/floor are optional outside apartment developments; a type is never stock.
Each unit is distinct. Reusing a type never shares its price or reservation.

mcd.title: Deals, holds and optional finance
mcd.subtitle: Customer proposals, reservation, closing and collection are different facts.
notes: Offering target is a physical property OR an entire development, never both.
Only one active hold per offering; full reservation history may contain many.

entities.name: Customer offer
attrs: Acceptance is not a deal close

mcd.title: Requirements, matching and activity
mcd.subtitle: Independent searches, exact offerings and actions attributed to their real author.
notes: Required and preferred criteria are distinct; unknown is not zero.
Shortlists are many-to-many associations resolved into a link table in the MLD.

mcd.title: Visits and administrator-controlled schedule
mcd.subtitle: Three visit types share a calendar; only company-car visits consume capacity.
notes: Office visits bypass working windows and capacity. Both off-site types follow hours.
Policy is versioned; company-car capacity starts at two agency-wide per local hour.

entities.name: Visit
attrs: Company car / no company car / office

mcd.title: Protected documents and scoped file access
mcd.subtitle: Shared inventory documents and private owner evidence must remain separate.
notes: Document belongs to exactly one of four typed parents; each parent link is optional.
A permit is tied to a session, action and real resource; no public file URLs.

entities.name: Document version
attrs: Private object, hash, MIME and size

mcd.title: Import and website-form intake
mcd.subtitle: Validate first, commit all eligible contacts atomically and protect retries.
notes: Existing phone identities are skipped and reported; no partial accepted batch.
Website receipts create enquiries, never expose contact existence to the form.

entities.name: Import row
attrs: Agent per row and validation errors

mld.title: Identity and access
mld.subtitle: One agency, named staff, revocable sessions and safe command receipts.
notes: Existing ORM/migration tables are solid. Planned tables are dashed.
Rate limiting uses an HMAC key; it has no direct user foreign key.

mld.title: Contact identity and responsibility
mld.subtitle: A lead is an enquiry, not a second copy of the contact.
notes: Active E.164 phone is unique; one primary per non-empty collection.
Contact roles do not grant staff permissions. Transfer keeps true authorship.

mld.title: Developments and physical inventory
mld.subtitle: Reusable types describe units; only actual properties count as stock.
notes: Standalone property: development/floor/type links are all NULL.
Apartment unit: same-development floor and type required. Mixed projects allowed.

mld.title: Legal owners and sale/rental offerings
mld.subtitle: Separate commercial campaigns for one property or a whole development.
notes: Offering target XOR: exactly one of property_id or development_id.
One current sale and one current rental per target. Multiple owners allowed.

mld.title: Requirements and shortlists
mld.subtitle: Independent needs, explicit criteria and exact offering matches.
notes: Criterion importance: required or preferred. Unknown values remain NULL.
Monthly rental annual equivalent = amount × 12; original terms are retained.

mld.title: Deals, reservations and outcomes
mld.subtitle: Fixed pipeline, explicit holds and append-only close/reopen history.
notes: One active reservation per offering; no automatic reservation expiry.
Project/unit overlap is checked under locks. Closing effects are transactional.

mld.title: Visit calendar and dynamic working times
mld.subtitle: Office anytime; off-site within working windows; company-car capacity only.
notes: Policy belongs to the agency; only an administrator may edit it.
Capacity counts every local hour intersected by [start,end), end excluded.

mld.title: Activity, tasks and durable background work
mld.subtitle: True actors, internal notifications and retriable PostgreSQL jobs/outbox.
notes: Typed context FKs preserve contact/deal/property integrity; no generic IDs.
Business effect + history + outbox commit together; dedupe keys prevent repeats.

mld.title: Private documents and temporary file access
mld.subtitle: Exactly one real parent; quarantine precedes every protected download.
notes: Document parent XOR: contact, development, property or deal.
Owner/developer private evidence stays on contact; permits bind session/resource.

mld.title: Optional commissions and collection ledger
mld.subtitle: Manager-controlled recognition, receipts and linked corrections.
notes: Commission is optional. Balance is derived, never directly editable.
Reject over-collection. Original records remain; final MAD rounding is once.

mld.title: Atomic import, website intake and retry safety
mld.subtitle: Preview/correction before one commit; replay-safe website receipts.
notes: Existing phone rows are skipped and reported; invalid rows block approval.
No partial batch. Retry records preserve request identity and original result.
